latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator Free CapCut — Initial Release

- Instantly generate and export short videos with AI, including transitions, music, and text overlays from user-provided clips or images.
- Simple upload of video (MP4, MOV, etc.) and image (JPG, PNG, etc.) files up to 500MB; no local installation required.
- Automatic connection to backend API using either a user token or a free 7-day demo token.
- Supports key actions: upload, generate/edit, export, check balance, and preview timeline via intuitive chat prompts.
- Fast cloud-based processing and export; typical video turnaround is 30-60 seconds for clips under 1 minute.
- Optimized for creators who want CapCut-style AI video editing for TikTok and Reels without app downloads.
